title: ToolCallContext
description: Helper struct to generate the full `_meta` schema. This matches how it appears in the JSON-RPC parameters.

IdeMetadata.description:
Metadata provided by the IDE context for every tool call.

This structure represents the `_meta` field in the JSON-RPC params. It allows the IDE to inject contextual information that is not part of the tool's arguments, such as the current project root, conversation ID, or active file.

active_file.description: The active file being edited (if any).

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier for the current conversation.

cursor_line.description: The line number of the cursor (if any).

project_root.description: The root directory of the project.
